title: Alan Saret, Author of Transcendent Wire Sculptures, Dead at 81
summary: Sculptor Alan Saret, whose nebulous, three-dimensional wire works seemed to pulse with life, died on May 26 in Brooklyn. He was eighty-one. His death was announced by the gallery Karma, which represented him. title: From the Archive: Stephen Shore’s Summer Break
summary: In the Summer of 1973, photographer Stephen Shore traveled West for a six-week road trip across the US.
